how_to_sign_off: Both teammates review this file and configs/v5_crop_windows.json, edit if needed, then set status to SIGNED_OFF, list both names and the date, and commit BEFORE any historical (non-dry-run) V5 run. The runner refuses real-data fitting otherwise.
question: Does better weather data - six Arabica regions, crop-stage timing - add to price-only forecasts of a large Coffee C rise, tested over a longer history?

model_notes.B0: historical frequency of the event in matured training labels (unchanged)
model_notes.A1: B1 + single-point rainfall and temperature anomalies (unchanged from V1-V4)
model_notes.A3: B1 + multi-region crop-stage weather: worst-region frost nights, weighted flowering rain anomaly, weighted grain-fill dry spell

price_history_reason: 2000-2007 has many blank sessions (holiday weeks) and yields few complete windows; 2008+ adds about 33 independent 63-session windows and the 2014 drought. Calendar for 2008-2018 is as unverified as for 2019+.

label_sensitivity.rule: a crossing counts only on sessions with reported volume >= 1,000 that are not suspected roll days (data_tools/make_liquidity_mask.py); window completeness unchanged

uncertainty.method: moving-block bootstrap of paired Brier differences, block = horizon

model_settings: unchanged from V4: training-only scaling, L2 logistic regression, C=1, lbfgs, max_iter 2000, tol 1e-8, seed 42, no class weighting
not_in_v5: freight models (V4 results stand as recorded)
reporting_rule: Report every threshold/horizon cell and every scope, favourable or not.
